newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKO SEES '97 PROFIT AT LEAST MATCHING '96.
newsitem.headline: OKO SEES '97 PROFIT AT LEAST MATCHING '96.

text.p: Finnish bank Osuuspankkien Keskuspankki Oy (OKOBANK) said on Tuesday it expected full-year 1997 operating profit to at least match last year's 230 million markka.

"For the entire year, OKOBANK Consolidated is in a good position to achieve a net operating profit that is at least at the previous year's level," OKO said in a statement with its January-June results.
The bank said first-half earnings -- operating profit after credit losses up three percent at 174 million markka -- had been better than forecast.
